fixed_point_model.source_table_display_scale: degree × 10000 with four decimal source places

formula.source_table_unit_relation: source-table 盈縮加分/盈縮積 values equal degree magnitude × 10000
formula.message_source_table_units: M(n)=A(n)-A(n+1), where both adjacent 盈縮加分 rows exist
formula.message_terminal_blank_rule: 消息分 is blank once no next 盈縮加分 row exists

formula.source_table_unit_relation: source-table 盈縮加分/盈縮積 values equal degree magnitude × 10000
formula.message_source_table_units: M(n)=A(n)-A(n+1), where both adjacent 盈縮加分 rows exist
formula.message_terminal_blank_rule: 消息分 is blank once no next 盈縮加分 row exists

interpolation_semantics.select_family: 盈初/縮末 use first table; 縮初/盈末 use second table after source-defined initial/terminal classification
interpolation_semantics.row_selection: whole-day index n; exact initial-limit cutoffs cap admissible n+fraction
interpolation_semantics.terminal_support_rows: day 89 and day 94 provide table-end accumulated support but are outside their exact initial-limit cutoff and have no next interpolation add value

cross_regional_control.observed_use: early rows preserve the same Shoushi solar table values and independently corroborate fixed-point place semantics

primary_table_schema.message_column_semantics: 消息分(n) = 盈縮加分(n) - 盈縮加分(n+1); the last message-bearing row is day 87 for 盈初縮末 and day 92 for 縮初盈末.
